task: Terrain-aware cinematic actor drag and native mouse camera ownership repair

requestedSpawn.note: Existing explicitly requested agent reused; backend model resolution not independently surfaced.

rootCauses.issue: Mouse orbit was consumed by empty-looking actor/original regions
rootCauses.evidence: Before source changes, actual canvas.dispatchEvent -> native SceneInputManager -> ArcRotateCamera orbit/pan passed in empty space. The same native gesture through a hollow Torus native mesh MISS/AABB hit entered actor drag and left camera alpha unchanged. Unadopted originals also claimed DOWN merely for selection.

rootCauses.issue: Actors could not be placed onto hills
rootCauses.evidence: Interaction intersected every pointer ray with the original actor-Y plane. Native body drag onto a real TerrainHeightField/CreateTerrainGround slope retained old Y instead of preserving clearance over the new ground.

changes: Exact authored actor geometry hits still own direct drag. AABB-only and unadopted original candidates remain click-selectable on UP only if movement<=3CSSpx; DOWN/MOVE/UP pass through for native camera gestures.

New cinematicTerrainHit(world,ray) tests the actual unpickable ground only, with bounded height-field fallback; cinematicGroundAtScreen accepts native canvas-local CSS pointer coordinates including DPR scaling.

Terrain drag preserves original worldY-terrainHeight(originalXZ) foot/floating offset and recomputes terrain Y after horizontal grab offset. Explicit rotation/scale stay unchanged; no ground hit at drag start retains the prior fixed-altitude plane behavior.
Cancel/blur/dispose restores exact original actor pose without onChange; successful final UP commits once including no-intervening-MOVE endpoint.
game-tool-lease source remained unchanged because actual native lease pointer delivery/orbit/pan/restore was already working.

api.coordinates: Screen x/y are canvas-local CSS pixels; capture center uses canvas.getBoundingClientRect().width/2,height/2.

before.note: Run before source edits; confirms native stream works and reproduces AABB orbit and hill clearance defects.

legacyClick.note: Root explicitly approved changing only obsolete DOWN expectation to true DOWN+UP click.

coverage: Actual CSS-offset/DPR2 canvas events and native pointer/camera input; no fake scene.pick or direct observable-only substitutes in new fixture.
Orbit -> pan -> orbit; post-body-drag orbit; pan over actor; exact manual-game input-map restoration.
Native hollow mesh miss and bounding fallback click selection.
Actual terrain slope, retained2m floating clearance, final-UP endpoint, navigation identity unchanged.
Pointercancel, blur and dispose pose/capture/camera cleanup.
Original prop orbit gesture vs stationary one-click selection without clone/mutation.
Shared ground helper actual geometry, DPR2 center, bounded height solver and immutable input ray.

limits: No browser automation, screenshots or physical-device claims.
Independent actual shipped actor/terrain and full game repair gate is owned by verifier C.
Height fallback sampling is bounded; actual ground geometry is queried first. No navigation, terrain geometry, material, texture, LOD, gameplay/combat-stat edits.
